---
title: "SAR workshop prompts a report for the NZ Space Agency"
date: 2024-09-04
date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"   # exact date known; other items show the year only
description: "A one-day workshop on the future of radar remote sensing, organised under Rodrigo's lead, prompted the New Zealand Space Agency to ask for a report."
categories: [event, report]
---

Practitioners, industry and academia met on 4 September 2024 for the New Zealand SAR
Workshop, a one-day meeting on the future of radar remote sensing in New Zealand, with
Rodrigo Gomez-Fell leading the organisation. The outcome: the New Zealand Space Agency asked
the organising committee for a report, now listed on the [Reports](../reports.qmd) page.
More about the workshop is on the [Teaching](../teaching.qmd#sar-workshop-2024) page.
